source_clause: EDPR3.2) If user is in the process of viewing/doing any of the above listed items, system should return to previous available page and play the bonk and show the message specified above. ****R1 High Only: "Stellantis Account" to be replaced with "Connected Account"
leaf_desc_037: If the user is actively in the process of viewing or performing any of the restricted actions (Deleting a Profile, editing username/avatar, Tutorials, Resume Setup, or viewing linked info) and the vehicle transitions into motion, the system must immediately interrupt the task and force-return the user to the previous available/safe page.

must_carry_injected.text: ****R1 High Only: "Stellantis Account" to be replaced with "Connected Account"

reasoning: 驗證目標：9.3.2（EDPR3.2）—— 使用者正在進行受限項目時車輛轉為行進，系統須返回前一個可用頁面並播 bonk 與顯示訊息。關鍵情境條件：受測之受限項目取「編輯 username」一項即足以觸發，其判準為車輛由靜止轉入行進之狀態轉換（§12 首匹配 → 狀態轉換）。為什麼這樣切：訊息字串「Function not available while vehicle in Motion.」出自 9.3.1，條文以「the message specified above」指之，故 specification_reference 併列 9.3.1（§10.7），非自擬。刻意略過：9.3.1 之「行進中選取受限項目」為另一觸發（選取 vs 進行中），由該 leaf 承擔；本 TC 之字面值依 R-U35 (c) 用 Connected Account。

tcs.tc_title: Restricted Profile action interrupted when vehicle starts moving
tcs.test_item: Restricted Profile action interrupted when vehicle starts moving
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A Driver Profile is active and the Edit Profile tab is available
2. The vehicle is stationary on a test track and can be brought into motion
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Edit Profile tab and start editing the Profile username
2. Bring the vehicle into motion
3. Read the screen and check that the previous available page is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The username editing page is displayed
2. The vehicle is in motion
3. The previous available page is displayed, the bonk tone is played, and “Function not available while vehicle in Motion.” is displayed
tcs.priority_basis: 行車中之工作中斷 —— **防線成立本身**（§10.2 safety；D-UP16-01 附二）
tcs.remarks: 9.3.2 之變體覆寫為**列級**（PDF p14 之 Table EDPR1 該列），本 TC 不含帳號 label，故不設變體前提（J-5）
